headline.en: FAT10 interface residues reported by the system (based on the molecular-dynamics contact data, judged by the system): none. Note: the literature/NMR-expected binding region is residues 6–81 of FAT10 (cited, not derived by this system); whether the two agree is under “Points to watch” below.

plain.zh: 分子动力学里稳定接触的 FAT10 残基(C160, Y161, C162, I163, G164, G165,位于第 160–165 位),全部在文献预期的第 6–81 位之外:两者不一致。系统只报告这个矛盾,不判断哪一方正确。
plain.en: The FAT10 residues in stable contact in the molecular dynamics (C160, Y161, C162, I163, G164, G165, at positions 160–165): all of them lie outside the literature-expected region (residues 6–81), so the two disagree. The system only reports this contradiction and does not say which side is right.

findings.basis: MD contact fraction >= 0.5: C160, Y161, C162, I163, G164, G165; literature-expected region 6–81; 6 of 6 outside it

plain.zh: 界面位于预期的 UBL1 区域之外。
plain.en: The interface is outside the expected UBL1 region.

plain.zh: 界面主要由 UBL2 和 C 端尾部主导。
plain.en: The interface is dominated by UBL2 and the C-terminal tail.

plain.zh: 柔性的 Gly-Gly 尾部接触是可能的，可能是 AF3 错误对接的假象。
plain.en: A flexible Gly-Gly tail contact is possible, possibly an AF3 mis-docking artifact.

plain.zh: MD 接触与 AF3 起始构象自洽，属于循环证据。
plain.en: The MD contacts are self-consistent with the AF3 starting pose, which is circular evidence.

plain.zh: 没有全长 FAT10-MAD2 复合物的实验结构。
plain.en: There is no experimental structure of the full-length FAT10-MAD2 complex.

plain.zh: 文献预期来自分离的 UBL1 NMR 和功能研究，而非全长复合物。
plain.en: The literature expectation comes from isolated UBL1 NMR and functional studies, not from the full-length complex.

plain.zh: 所有 15 个 MD 残基均针对 UniProt O15205 验证，0 个不匹配。
plain.en: All 15 MD residues were validated against UniProt O15205 with 0 mismatches.

caveat.zh: FAT10–MAD2 没有实验解出的复合物结构:如果 MD 结果与文献预期不一致,系统只报告矛盾,不判定哪一方正确。
caveat.en: There is no experimentally solved FAT10–MAD2 complex: if the MD result and the literature expectation disagree, the system only reports the contradiction and does not decide which side is right.

conclusion.details: Literature/NMR expectation (UniProt O15205 feature table; Theng et al. 2014 PNAS; PDB 2MBE) places the MAD2-binding region in the N-terminal ubiquitin-like domain UBL1 (residues 6-81). The real 100 ns MD contact occupancy instead concentrates on the C-terminal region: I163 (1.0), C162 (0.998), G164 (0.957), C160 (0.706), G165 (0.656), Y161 (0.613), plus D97 (0.471), K137 (0.43), A159 (0.349), R138 (0.227) - all in UBL2 (90-163) or the C-terminal tail (164-165), OUTSIDE UBL1. Only K31 (0.115) and R60 (0.076) fall inside UBL1, and both are weak. All 15 MD residue labels validated against the real UniProt sequence with 0 mismatches, so the data is not fabricated - the conflict is real, not a numbering artifact. The debate confirms the contradiction (confidence 0.9) but low confidence in which side is correct (0.2): the literature expectation derives from isolated-UBL1 NMR and functional studies, while the MD interface is a 100 ns trajectory seeded from an AlphaFold3 pose and may reflect a mis-docked flexible Gly-Gly C-terminal tail that MD then preserves (partly circular evidence). No experimental full-length FAT10-MAD2 structure exists, so neither side is ground truth. I therefore report the contradiction as fact without declaring a winner, and recommend orthogonal experiments (CSP-NMR titrating full-length FAT10 and separate UBL1/UBL2 constructs with MAD2, XL-MS, HDX-MS), independent MD re-runs from a UBL1-docked pose, and a G164A/G165A tail mutant to test whether the C-terminal contact is required.
